method: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=20, shuffle=True, random_state=42) with patient_id groups; folds 0-2=test, 3-5=validation, 6-19=train. Each patient belongs to exactly one fold by construction, so no patient can appear in two splits.
lesion_id_note: lesion_id is NOT used for grouping: 250 lesion ids are reused across different patients in PAD-UFES-20.
test_set_policy: test folds were excluded from preprocessing fits, early stopping, and threshold selection
